All source code, unit tests, and Playwright E2E tests have been implemented adhering strictly to the additive-only, token-pure, no-external-dependencies, and zero-command-run constraints.

1. **3D Outliner Tree (`src/editor/panels/layers/Outliner3d.tsx`)**:
   - Mounted in [LeftPanelConnected.tsx](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/editor/panels/layers/LeftPanelConnected.tsx) via an additive branch when `useViewportStore((s) => s.editingSceneId)` is active.

   - Blender-style click selection updating both `useViewportStore` and IDE `useSelectionStore`, with Shift and Ctrl multi-selection.
   - Inline double-click and Enter key renaming calling `3d.outliner.rename`.
   - Drag-and-drop reparenting onto objects via `3d.outliner.reparent` (strictly preserving world transforms) and onto collections via `3d.outliner.move_to_collection`, with visual drop indicator feedback.
   - User count badges via `userCounts(doc)` on shared blocks with a "Make single user" button calling `3d.blocks.make_single_user`.
   - Keyboard navigation (arrows move/expand/collapse, Enter renames, Delete/Backspace deletes via `3d.object.delete` / `3d.outliner.delete`) routed through the command system without raw window keydown listeners.
   - Right-click context menu offering "Copy attributes", "Paste attributes to selected" (`3d.blocks.copy_attributes`), specific attribute pasting, "Make single user", "Rename", and "Delete".
